Unobtainable Unit
This unit is currently unobtainable since Update 6.5 - Jujutsu Kaisen Update Part 2

Overview

Elize is a MythicalMythical Limited unit. She was only obtainable through summoning during the Heavenly Invasion event.

She can evolve into Elize (Random Equip- /Lightning/True Heart/Valkyrie) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.
